_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate dominates: no 24h calendar trigger or >2% trend breaker, crowded longs/dead flows cancel DXY/CVD bid, so score stays in Denial band.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Denial; narrative silent on phase but metals risk-off is compatible with CAUTION, not a directional break
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds ~30-40, funding near flat, next 12h no >2% trend day
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed <25 with funding negative (Panic) or >46 on momentum reversal (Anxiety+)
